scope: Isolated GitHub Pages web alpha: complete Wavetable Rack engine and WASM U4 optimization. Pending Control/MIDI feature changes remain outside this release. Stable 1.0 device/DAW gates are not claimed.

memory.scope: Utility WASM high-water memory after one full 414-source sample-bank pass, not live allocations or total multi-context application RAM. Fixed embedded library/engine footprint is separated from scratch growth.
memory.note: The legacy 128 MiB absolute assertion did not allow for the larger fixed WT library/runtime. This alpha explicitly records 134.25 MiB total; the revised regression bounds startup and export growth separately. It does not close the original mobile acceptance gate.

cpu_provenance: CPU and browser-120-second results are in ../wasm-unison4/verification.json and refer to the measured optimized module. Same six DSP source hashes; this release separately verifies bit-identical dynamic PCM. No new CPU measurement is inferred from the packaging comparison.
